name: First Date Simulator
summary:
On a first date, everyone performs a little. First Date Simulator takes the stage away. No photo. No swipe. No profile to polish. Just someone across from you, asking.

Carly walks in, sits down, turns toward you and holds your gaze. She talks out loud. And she asks the things that would normally take three dates to ask. You don't type and you don't talk: a deck of five cards is strapped to your left hand, and you answer by throwing one. Yes!, Yes, Neutral, No, No way! The card you let fly says more about y
